displayName: [Preview]: Eligible Azure Arc-enabled Windows Server 2016 (or 2012) machines should have ESUs installed.
description: Windows Server 2016 (or 2012) Arc-enabled machines should have all applicable Extended Security Updates (ESUs) installed. This policy requires that Guest Configuration prerequisites have been deployed to the policy assignment scope. For Guest Configuration prerequisites and setup information, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of this policy
